name: stat-arb-pairs
license: No license found: GitHub metadata reports license null, the main tree has no LICENSE file, and pyproject.toml has no license field; default copyright applies.
methods: OLS Engle-Granger cointegration on adjusted price levels with residual z-score mean reversion
Directional Engle-Granger screening using max of two p-values, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at 0.05, and Johansen trace confirmation
252-bar rolling formation and 63-bar non-overlapping trading blocks with frozen OLS hedge or causal Kalman hedge
Explicit two-leg spread and slippage costs plus dynamic-beta re-hedge cost
AR(1) OU half-life diagnostics, 2 to 40 bar rank band, optional three-half-life time stop
Nested q_beta selection on 84/21 inner windows over 1e-8 to 1e-4
reuseDecision: Do not reuse or port repository code: no actual license is present, so default copyright applies. Independently implement the general published statistical methods in TypeScript with a clean-room design; retain no copied code, tests, prose, identifiers, or notebook material. Add only analysis and PAPER simulation, never brokerage execution.
requirements: Aligned daily price-level history with appropriate corporate-action treatment, retained provider/as-of provenance, symbol mapping, and sufficient 252 plus 63 bar history
A selected equity universe and current-safe point-in-time policy; use user-provided licensed CSVs or procure a provider credential and plan whose terms cover intended storage/display/use
Do not use yfinance/Yahoo as a production data contract: it is described as research/education and personal-use only, while Yahoo terms restrict automated collection without permission
Visible paper assumptions for z thresholds, formation/trading dates, FDR level, costs, borrow/impact limitations, and next-bar timing; no broker credential, order routing, or queue-fill model
Experimental Kalman mode must expose q_alpha 1e-4, q_beta 1e-6, 60-bar warm-up, and optional nested q_beta grid rather than claiming universal defaults
